# Documentation for `scw dataviz`
DataViz API.

## Manage your DataViz deployment

Manage your DataViz deployment.


### Create a new DataViz deployment

Create a new DataViz deployment.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw dataviz deployment create [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name                                                 | Description                                                                 | Argument Specifications                     |
|------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------|
| project-id                                           | Project ID to use. If none is passed the default project ID will be used    |                                             |
| name                                                 | Name of the deployment                                                      |                                             |
| tags.{index}                                         | Tags                                                                        |                                             |
| node-count                                           | Number of nodes                                                             |                                             |
| node-type                                            | Node type to use                                                            |                                             |
| user-name                                            | Username for the deployment user                                            |                                             |
| password                                             | Password for the deployment user                                            |                                             |
| volume.type                                          | Type of the Volume                                                          | One of: `unknown_type`, `sbs_5k`, `sbs_15k` |
| volume.size-bytes                                    | Size of the Volume                                                          |                                             |
| endpoints.{index}.public                             |                                                                             |                                             |
| endpoints.{index}.private-network.private-network-id |                                                                             |                                             |
| version                                              | The DataViz version to use                                                  |                                             |
| region                                               | Region to target. If none is passed will use default region from the config | Default: `fr-par`<br />One of: `fr-par`     |



### Delete a DataViz deployment

Delete a DataViz deployment.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw dataviz deployment delete [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name          | Description                                                                 | Argument Specifications                 |
|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| deployment-id | ID of the deployment                                                        | Required                                |
| region        | Region to target. If none is passed will use default region from the config | Default: `fr-par`<br />One of: `fr-par` |



### Retrieve a specific DataViz deployment

Retrieve a specific DataViz deployment.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw dataviz deployment get [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name          | Description                                                                 | Argument Specifications                 |
|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| deployment-id | ID of the deployment                                                        | Required                                |
| region        | Region to target. If none is passed will use default region from the config | Default: `fr-par`<br />One of: `fr-par` |



### Retrieve a list of DataViz deployments

Retrieve a list of DataViz deployments.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw dataviz deployment list [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name            | Description                                                                                         | Argument Specifications                                                                                   |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| project-id      | Project ID to filter for, only deployments from this Project will be returned                       |                                                                                                           |
| order-by        | Sort order for deployments in the response                                                          | One of: `created_at_asc`, `created_at_desc`, `name_asc`, `name_desc`, `updated_at_asc`, `updated_at_desc` |
| tags.{index}    | Tags to filter for, only deployments with one or more matching tags will be returned                |                                                                                                           |
| name            | Deployment name to filter for, only deployments with this string within their name will be returned |                                                                                                           |
| organization-id | Organization ID to filter for, only deployments from this Organization will be returned             |                                                                                                           |
| region          | Region to target. If none is passed will use default region from the config                         | Default: `fr-par`<br />One of: `fr-par`, `all`                                                            |



### Update a DataViz deployment

Update a DataViz deployment.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw dataviz deployment update [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name          | Description                                                                 | Argument Specifications                 |
|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| deployment-id | ID of the deployment                                                        | Required                                |
| name          | New name for the deployment                                                 |                                         |
| tags.{index}  | Tags to update                                                              |                                         |
| region        | Region to target. If none is passed will use default region from the config | Default: `fr-par`<br />One of: `fr-par` |



### Upgrade a DataViz deployment

Upgrade a DataViz deployment.

**Usage:**

```shell
scw dataviz deployment upgrade [arg=value ...]
```


**Arguments:**

| Name              | Description                                                                 | Argument Specifications                 |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| deployment-id     | ID of the deployment                                                        | Required                                |
| node-count        | Target number of nodes                                                      |                                         |
| volume-size-bytes | Target volume size                                                          |                                         |
| region            | Region to target. If none is passed will use default region from the config | Default: `fr-par`<br />One of: `fr-par` |



## Manage your DataViz deployment endpoints

### Create a new endpoint for a deployment

**Usage:**

```shell

```


**Arguments:**

| Name                                             | Description                                                                 | Argument Specifications                 |
|--------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| deployment-id                                    | ID of the deployment                                                        |                                         |
| endpoint-spec.public                             |                                                                             |                                         |
| endpoint-spec.private-network.private-network-id |                                                                             |                                         |

## List available node types


## List your DataViz versions

List your DataViz versions.

List available DataViz versions.

**Usage:**

```shell

```
